stem: In the excerpt from “The Leper’s Squint,” how does the tone of the wife’s dialogue influence the way the character of Desmond is perceived?
instruction: Use “The Leper’s Squint” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: Her focus on the factual creates a strong contrast to Desmond’s artistic sense.

options.label: B
options.text: Her light-hearted attitude only emphasizes Desmond’s internal struggle.

options.label: C
options.text: Her repeated criticism makes the reader sympathetic towards Desmond.

options.label: D
options.text: Her ease at coping makes Desmond appear lazy in comparison.
